Commercial premises for sale in a commercial area, next to the Vértice hotel, a high-traffic location with several bars and shops nearby. Pedestrian area. Good location. Sold with a tenant. The premises are currently rented with an option to renew for up to 5 years. Business is operating with no issues regarding rent collection.
The buyer must respect the tenant's rental contract.
Good investment.
The premises include 11 outdoor tables.. . with a porch that would be a private area and public thoroughfare.
Interested parties contact me. No intermediaries. Private seller.
